meaning.en: Om, the sacred syllable
the Yogachudamani, crown-jewel of yoga
I will describe
out of a wish for the benefit of yogis
meaning.hi: योगियों के हित की कामना से

meaning.en: granting the attainment of absolute freedom
hidden, secret
cherished by the greatest knowers of yoga
meaning.hi: योग के श्रेष्ठतम ज्ञाताओं द्वारा सेवित

meaning.en: posture
control/restraint of the breath
and withdrawal of the senses
concentration
meditation
absorption
these are the six limbs of yoga
meaning.hi: ये छह योग के अंग हैं

meaning.en: one is taught as the accomplished seat
the second is the lotus seat
six wheels of energy (chakras)
sixteen supporting points
three points of focus
five regions likened to space
one who does not know their own body
meaning.hi: जो अपने शरीर को नहीं जानता

meaning.en: how can accomplishment come to him
the first support has four petals
the self-establishment center has six petals
at the navel, a ten-petaled lotus
meaning.hi: नाभि में दस पंखुड़ियों वाला कमल

meaning.en: at the heart, one with twelve spokes
the one called pure, with sixteen petals (at the throat)
and between the eyebrows, one with two petals
meaning.hi: और भौंहों के बीच दो पंखुड़ियों वाला

meaning.en: counted as having a thousand petals
meaning.hi: सहस्र पंखुड़ियों वाला गिना जाता है

meaning.en: at the great highway, the opening at the crown
the base center is the first wheel
the self-establishment center is the second
the place between the two lower openings
meaning.hi: दोनों द्वारों के बीच का स्थान

meaning.en: is called the seat of desire
at the anus is what is known by the name of desire
meaning.hi: गुदा-स्थान में जिसे काम नाम से जाना जाता है

meaning.en: a lotus with four petals
in the middle of that place sits the source
meaning.hi: उस स्थान के बीच में स्रोत स्थित है

meaning.en: called desire, honored by the accomplished masters
in the very middle of that, the great symbol of the formless
stands facing the west
meaning.hi: पश्चिम की ओर मुख किए स्थित है

meaning.en: at the navel, a mirror/jewel-like circle
whoever knows it is a true knower of yoga
meaning.hi: जो इसे जानता है वह योगवित् है

meaning.en: gleaming like molten gold
meaning.hi: पिघले सोने की भाँति चमकता हुआ

meaning.en: flashing like a streak of lightning
meaning.hi: बिजली की लकीर की तरह कौंधता हुआ

meaning.en: that triangular region belonging to fire
established below the genital organ
in deep absorption it is the supreme light
boundless, facing in every direction
meaning.hi: असीम, सब ओर मुख किए हुए

meaning.en: once that great union has been seen directly
meaning.hi: उस महायोग को साक्षात् देखने पर

meaning.en: there is no more coming and going
the breath takes form by its own inner sound
meaning.hi: प्राण अपनी ध्वनि से रूप लेता है

meaning.en: the self-establishment center becomes its resting ground
because it rests on the self-establishment center
that place is called the seat of the genital organ
meaning.hi: उसे जननेन्द्रिय का आश्रय कहा जाता है

meaning.en: strung together like beads on a thread
meaning.hi: धागे में पिरोए मोतियों की तरह

meaning.en: there is the bulb, source of the sushumna channel
in the circle of that navel is a wheel
called the city of jewels (manipuraka)
a great wheel of twelve spokes
free from merit and sin
so long a living being keeps wandering
meaning.hi: तब तक जीव भटकता रहता है

meaning.en: until it realizes this truth
meaning.hi: जब तक तत्त्व को नहीं जानता

meaning.en: above the genital organ, below the navel
meaning.hi: जननेन्द्रिय के ऊपर, नाभि के नीचे

meaning.en: in the bulb is the source, shaped like a bird's egg
meaning.hi: कन्द में स्रोत पक्षी के अण्डे समान है

meaning.en: from that source the channels arise
meaning.hi: वहाँ से नाड़ियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं

meaning.en: numbering seventy-two thousand
among those thousands of channels
seventy-two are especially spoken of
the main carriers of the vital breath
among these, ten are remembered
ida and pingala
and sushumna as the third
gandhari and hastijihva
pusha and yashasvini
alambusa and kuhu
shankhini remembered as the tenth
this entire wheel of channels
should always be known by yogis
ida is situated on the left side
meaning.hi: इडा बाएँ भाग में स्थित है

meaning.en: pingala is situated on the right
meaning.hi: पिंगला दाएँ भाग में स्थित है

meaning.en: sushumna is in the middle region
gandhari at the left eye
hastijihva at the right eye
pusha at the right ear
yashasvini at the left ear
alambusa at the mouth
kuhu runs to the genital region
shankhini at the root/perineal area
relying on these gateways in this way
the channels stand in fixed order
meaning.hi: नाड़ियाँ क्रम से स्थित रहती हैं

meaning.en: ida, pingala, and sushumna
are established along the breath's pathway
constantly carrying the vital breath
moon, sun, and fire are their presiding deities
meaning.hi: चन्द्र, सूर्य और अग्नि इनकी अधिष्ठात्री देवता हैं

meaning.en: known as prana, apana, samana
and vyana, udana -- the winds
naga, kurma, and krikara
devadatta and dhananjaya
prana always stays in the heart
meaning.hi: प्राण सदा हृदय में स्थित है

meaning.en: apana in the region of the anus
samana stays in the navel region
udana travels through the middle of the throat
vyana pervades the entire body
these are the five main winds
naga is known to work in belching
kurma in the opening of the eyes
krikara should be known as causing sneezing
meaning.hi: कृकर छींक उत्पन्न करने वाला जानना चाहिए

meaning.en: devadatta produces a yawn
does not leave even a dead body
meaning.hi: मृत शरीर को भी नहीं छोड़ता

meaning.en: dhananjaya pervades everything
these, in all the channels
keep living creatures wandering
struck by a hand/arm
just as a ball keeps moving
pulled by prana and apana together
so too the living being cannot rest
meaning.hi: वैसे ही जीव स्थिर नहीं रहता

meaning.en: the living being, ruled by prana and apana

words.sanskrit: hi adhah cha urdhvam cha dhavati

meaning.en: runs downward and upward
along the left and right pathways
because of restlessness it is not seen clearly
meaning.hi: चंचलता के कारण दिखाई नहीं देता

meaning.en: just as a falcon tied by a rope
flies off but is pulled back again
meaning.hi: उड़ जाता है पर फिर खींच लिया जाता है

meaning.en: so too the living being, bound by these forces
meaning.hi: वैसे ही गुणों से बँधा जीव

meaning.en: is drawn back by prana and apana
ruled by prana and apana, the living being

words.sanskrit: hi adhah cha urdhvam cha gacchati

meaning.en: runs downward and upward
apana pulls prana
and prana pulls apana
meaning.hi: और प्राण अपान को खींचता है

meaning.en: established in upward and downward movement
whoever knows these two is a true knower of yoga
meaning.hi: जो जानता है वह योगवित् है

meaning.en: on the sound ha the breath goes out
meaning.hi: ह ध्वनि पर श्वास बाहर जाती है

meaning.en: on the sound sa it enters again
meaning.hi: स ध्वनि पर पुनः प्रवेश करती है

meaning.en: this mantra, hamsa hamsa
a living being always repeats
six hundred times, day and night
twenty-one thousand in all
this mantra counted in this way
a living being always repeats
known as the ajapa gayatri (unrecited repetition)
always grants liberation to yogis
meaning.hi: योगियों को सदा मुक्ति देने वाली

meaning.en: simply by resolving to work with it
one is freed from all wrongdoing
meaning.hi: सभी पापों से मुक्त हो जाता है

meaning.en: no knowledge equals this
no recitation equals this
no wisdom equals this
neither in the past nor the future
meaning.hi: न भूत में न भविष्य में

meaning.en: born from kundalini, the coiled power
this gayatri sustains the vital breath
meaning.hi: यह गायत्री प्राण को धारण करती है

meaning.en: the knowledge of vital breath is the greatest knowledge
whoever knows it is a true knower of the Vedas
meaning.hi: जो इसे जानता है वह वेदवित् है

meaning.en: above the bulb, the power of kundalini
coiled in eight loops, spiral in shape
meaning.hi: आठ कुण्डलों में सर्पिल आकार की

meaning.en: the opening of the door of brahman, constantly
covers it with its own mouth
it is through this door one must pass
the untroubled door of brahman
covering that door with her mouth
meaning.hi: उस द्वार को मुख से ढककर

meaning.en: the supreme goddess lies asleep
she awakens through the working of fire
meaning.hi: अग्नि के योग से जागृत होती है

meaning.en: joined with the mind and with the breath
taking on a form as thin as a needle
travels upward through sushumna
meaning.hi: सुषुम्ना से होकर ऊपर जाती है

words.sanskrit: udghatayet kavatam tu yatha kunchikaya griham

meaning.en: just as a key opens a locked door
meaning.hi: जैसे कुंजी से घर खुलता है

meaning.en: so the yogi should force open the door of liberation with kundalini
meaning.hi: वैसे ही योगी कुण्डलिनी से मुक्ति-द्वार खोले

meaning.en: bringing the two palms together
sitting locked tightly in the lotus posture
chin drawn close to the chest
meaning.hi: ठोड़ी को वक्षस्थल के पास लाकर

words.sanskrit: varam-varam apanam urdhvam anilam prochchhArayet puritam munchan pranam upaiti bodham atulam shakti-prabhavat narah

meaning.en: repeatedly draw the breath upward and release it -- by this power one attains matchless understanding
meaning.hi: बार-बार वायु को ऊपर खींचकर छोड़े -- इस शक्ति से अतुलनीय बोध प्राप्त होता है

meaning.en: rubbing the limbs with the sweat produced from exertion
meaning.hi: परिश्रम से उत्पन्न पसीने से अंगों की मालिश करके

meaning.en: giving up pungent, sour, and salty food
one should take a diet of milk
one who practices celibacy and eats moderately
a yogi devoted to yoga
within a year becomes accomplished
meaning.hi: एक वर्ष के भीतर सिद्ध होता है

meaning.en: there is no need to doubt this
rich and sweet food
leaving one-quarter of the stomach empty
eating out of devotion to Shiva
meaning.hi: शिव की प्रसन्नता के लिए भोजन करना

meaning.en: this is called moderate eating
above the bulb, the power of kundalini, coiled in eight loops
meaning.hi: कन्द के ऊपर कुण्डलिनी शक्ति, आठ कुण्डलों में

meaning.en: a bond for those who are deluded
always granting liberation to yogis
meaning.hi: योगियों को सदा मुक्ति देने वाली

meaning.en: great seal, sky-facing seal, flying-up lock, and throat lock
whoever knows the root lock too
meaning.hi: जो मूल बन्ध को भी जानता है

meaning.en: that yogi is fit for liberation
meaning.hi: वह योगी मुक्ति का पात्र है

meaning.en: pressing firmly with the heel
contract the genital region tightly
draw the lower breath (apana) upward
this is how the root lock is performed
meaning.hi: इस तरह मूल बन्ध किया जाता है

meaning.en: the union of prana and apana
with reduction of urine and stool
even the old becomes young
meaning.hi: वृद्ध भी युवा हो जाता है

meaning.en: through the constant practice of the root lock
meaning.hi: मूल बन्ध के निरन्तर अभ्यास से

meaning.en: because it makes the great bird fly without rest, it is called uddiyana
meaning.hi: महाखग को निरन्तर उड़ाने के कारण उड्डियान कहलाता है

meaning.en: this uddiyana is like a lion facing the elephant of death
meaning.hi: यह उड्डियान मृत्यु-रूपी हाथी के सामने सिंह के समान है

words.sanskrit: udarat pashchimam tanam adho nabheh nigadyate

meaning.en: drawn back in the belly, below the navel
meaning.hi: पेट में नाभि के नीचे और पीछे

words.sanskrit: oddiyanam udare bandhah tatra bandhah vidhiyate

meaning.en: the flying-up lock is applied in the belly, at that very site
meaning.hi: उड्डियान बन्ध पेट में, उसी स्थान पर लगाया जाता है

meaning.en: it binds that which arises from the head
meaning.hi: यह सिर से उत्पन्न को बाँधता है

meaning.en: the nectar-like fluid that flows downward
therefore the throat lock, jalandhara
removes the entire flood of pain and suffering
meaning.hi: कष्ट-दुःख की बाढ़ को नष्ट करने वाला

meaning.en: when this lock is applied, marked by throat contraction
meaning.hi: जालन्धर बन्ध के लगने पर, कण्ठ-संकोच के लक्षण के साथ

meaning.en: the nectar does not fall into the fire
and the vital wind does not race away
the tongue, turned backward, inserted into the hollow at the base of the skull
meaning.hi: जिह्वा पीछे मुड़कर खोपड़ी के खोखले में प्रविष्ट

meaning.en: the gaze directed between the eyebrows
this becomes the khechari seal (moving through the sky)
for such a person, no disease, no death
no sleep, no hunger, no thirst
and such a person never falls unconscious
who knows the khechari seal
is not afflicted by disease
is not bound/marked by the results of past actions
cannot be constrained by anything at all
meaning.hi: किसी से भी बाध्य नहीं होता

meaning.en: who knows the khechari seal
because the mind roams in open space
meaning.hi: क्योंकि मन आकाश में विचरता है

meaning.en: and the tongue roams in that same space
meaning.hi: और जिह्वा उसी आकाश में विचरती है

meaning.en: hence this is the khechari seal
honored by all who have attained accomplishment
rooted in the source at the base
the channels are established from there
nourishing the body from the soles of the feet to the crown of the head
meaning.hi: तलवों से सिर के शिखर तक शरीर को पोषण देती हुई

meaning.en: whoever has sealed shut through the khechari seal
meaning.hi: जिसने खेचरी मुद्रा से सील कर दिया

meaning.en: the opening above the uvula
his precious fluid does not diminish
even when embraced by a lover
meaning.hi: प्रेमिका द्वारा आलिंगित होने पर भी

meaning.en: as long as the precious fluid remains in the body
meaning.hi: जब तक बिन्दु देह में स्थित है

meaning.en: why then any fear of death
as long as the sky-facing seal is held
that fluid does not move

words.sanskrit: jvalitah api yatha bindu sampraptah cha hutashanam

meaning.en: even when the fluid has been set ablaze and reaches the fire
meaning.hi: प्रज्वलित होकर अग्नि तक पहुँचा हुआ बिन्दु भी

meaning.en: it can travel upward through this power
meaning.hi: इस शक्ति से ऊपर यात्रा करता है

meaning.en: held back by the seal at the genital region

words.sanskrit: sah punah dvividhah binduh pandarah lohitah tatha

meaning.en: this precious fluid is of two kinds, pale and reddish
meaning.hi: यह द्रव दो प्रकार का है, श्वेत और रक्तिम

meaning.en: the pale one is called the white essence
the reddish one is called the great female essence
the reddish essence, like vermilion, resides at the sun's seat
the white essence rests at the moon's seat
the union of the two is exceptionally rare
the white essence is the seed, associated with divine power
meaning.hi: बिन्दु ब्रह्म है, रज शक्ति है

meaning.en: the white essence is the moon, the reddish essence is the sun
meaning.hi: बिन्दु चन्द्र है, रज सूर्य है

words.sanskrit: ubhayoh sangamat eva prapyate paramam padam

meaning.en: only through the meeting of the two is the supreme state attained
meaning.hi: दोनों के संगम से ही परम पद प्राप्त होता है

meaning.en: driven by the power of a moving breath
the reddish essence, propelled
reaches complete oneness with the white essence
meaning.hi: बिन्दु के साथ पूर्ण एकत्व को प्राप्त होता है

meaning.en: then the body becomes divine
meaning.hi: तब देह दिव्य हो जाती है

meaning.en: the white essence is joined with the moon
the reddish essence is connected with the sun
the equal blending of the two into one
whoever knows this is a true knower of yoga
meaning.hi: जो जानता है वह योगवित् है

meaning.en: purification of the entire channel network
stirring both moon and sun into motion
and drawing out the inner fluids
this is called the great seal

words.sanskrit: vakshah-nyasta-hanuh prapidya suchiram yonim cha vama-anghrina

meaning.en: chin resting on chest, pressing the genital region firmly with the left heel
meaning.hi: ठोड़ी छाती पर टिकाकर बाईं एड़ी से जननांग दबाकर

words.sanskrit: hastabhyam anudharayan prasaritam padam tatha dakshinam

meaning.en: holding the extended right leg with both hands
meaning.hi: दोनों हाथों से फैले दाहिने पैर को पकड़े हुए

words.sanskrit: apurya shvasanena kukshi-yugalam badhva shanaih rechayet

meaning.en: filling both sides of the belly with breath, then releasing it slowly
meaning.hi: श्वास से पेट के दोनों ओर भरकर धीरे छोड़े

words.sanskrit: seyam vyadhi-vinashini su-mahati mudra nrinam kathyate

meaning.en: this great disease-destroying seal is spoken of among people
meaning.hi: यह महान रोग-नाशक मुद्रा लोगों में कही जाती है

meaning.en: practicing on the moon side
then practicing again on the sun side
when the count on both sides becomes equal
meaning.hi: जब गिनती दोनों तरफ़ बराबर हो जाए

meaning.en: then that seal should be set aside
meaning.hi: तब उस मुद्रा को छोड़ दे

words.sanskrit: na hi pathyam apathyam va rasah sarve api nirasah

meaning.en: nothing suitable or unsuitable remains; every flavor becomes tasteless
meaning.hi: कुछ भी पथ्य-अपथ्य नहीं रहता, हर रस स्वादहीन हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: ati-bhuktam visham ghoram piyusham iva jiryate

meaning.en: even a severe poison taken in excess is digested like nectar
meaning.hi: अत्यधिक लिया गया घोर विष भी अमृत की तरह पच जाता है

meaning.en: tuberculosis, skin disease, rectal disorders, abdominal tumors, indigestion, and similar illnesses
meaning.hi: तपेदिक, कुष्ठ, गुदावर्त, गुल्म, अजीर्ण आदि रोग

words.sanskrit: tasya rogah kshayam yanti maha-mudram tu yah abhyaset

meaning.en: all such diseases come to an end for whoever practices the great seal
meaning.hi: उसके रोग नष्ट हो जाते हैं जो महामुद्रा का अभ्यास करता है

meaning.en: this great seal has been explained, granting people great accomplishment
meaning.hi: यह महामुद्रा वर्णित हुई, लोगों को महासिद्धि देने वाली

words.sanskrit: gopaniya prayatnena na deya yasya kasyachit

meaning.en: it must be guarded with effort, not given to just anyone
meaning.hi: प्रयत्न से गुप्त रखी जाए, किसी को भी न दी जाए

meaning.en: seated firmly in the lotus posture, body and neck evenly aligned
meaning.hi: पद्मासन में बैठकर, शरीर-गर्दन समान रूप से संरेखित

meaning.en: gazing at the tip of the nose, in solitude
meaning.hi: नासिका के अग्रभाग पर दृष्टि, एकान्त में

meaning.en: one should recite the imperishable syllable Om

words.sanskrit: om nityam shuddham buddham nirvikalpam niranjanam

meaning.en: Om is eternal, pure, awake, beyond mental construction, untouched by stain
meaning.hi: ॐ नित्य, शुद्ध, जाग्रत, निर्विकल्प, निरञ्जन है

meaning.en: unnamed, without beginning or end, the one, the fourth state

words.sanskrit: yat bhutam bhavat bhavishyat parivartamanam sarvada anavachchhinnam param brahma

meaning.en: changing through past, present and future yet never limited -- the supreme brahman
meaning.hi: भूत-वर्तमान-भविष्य से बदलता, फिर भी अपरिच्छिन्न -- परब्रह्म

words.sanskrit: tasmat jata para shaktih svayam jyotih-atmika

meaning.en: from that arises a supreme power, self-luminous by nature
meaning.hi: उससे परा शक्ति उत्पन्न होती है, स्वयं ज्योतिस्वरूप

words.sanskrit: atmanah akashah sambhutah akashat vayuh vayoh agnih agneh apah adbhyah prithivi

meaning.en: from self, space; from space, air; from air, fire; from fire, water; from water, earth
meaning.hi: आत्मा से आकाश, आकाश से वायु, वायु से अग्नि, अग्नि से जल, जल से पृथ्वी

meaning.en: the five presiding forces of these elements: Sadashiva, Ishvara, Rudra, Vishnu, Brahma
meaning.hi: इन पाँच भूतों के पाँच अधिष्ठाता: सदाशिव, ईश्वर, रुद्र, विष्णु, ब्रह्मा

meaning.en: among these, Brahma, Vishnu and Rudra are responsible for creation, sustaining, dissolution

words.sanskrit: rajasah brahma sattvikah vishnuh tamasah rudrah iti ete trayah guna-yuktah

meaning.en: Brahma carries rajas, Vishnu sattva, Rudra tamas -- the three qualities
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा रजोगुणी, विष्णु सत्त्वगुणी, रुद्र तमोगुणी -- तीन गुणयुक्त

meaning.en: Brahma was the first among the gods to come into being
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा देवताओं में सबसे पहले उत्पन्न हुए

words.sanskrit: dhata cha srishtau vishnush cha sthitau rudrash cha nashe bhogaya chandra iti prathamajah babhuvuh

meaning.en: the giver at creation, Vishnu at sustaining, Rudra at dissolution, and the moon for enjoyment -- the first-born
meaning.hi: सृष्टि में दाता, स्थिति में विष्णु, नाश में रुद्र, भोग के लिए चन्द्र -- प्रथमजात

meaning.en: through organs of knowledge and action, sense objects, the five vital winds, mind, intellect, awareness, ego -- all shaped coarsely
meaning.hi: ज्ञानेन्द्रिय-कर्मेन्द्रिय, विषय, पाँच वायु, मन-बुद्धि-चित्त-अहंकार से -- स्थूल रूप से गढ़ा

meaning.en: this is called the gross form of nature

words.sanskrit: jnana-karma-indriyaih jnana-vishayaih prana-adi-pancha-vayu-mano-buddhibhih cha sukshma-sthah api lingam eva iti uchyate

meaning.en: through organs, sense objects, five winds, mind and intellect, existing subtly, this is called the subtle body
meaning.hi: इन्द्रिय, विषय, पाँच वायु, मन-बुद्धि से सूक्ष्म रूप से विद्यमान, यह लिंग शरीर कहलाता है

meaning.en: the underlying cause, woven with the three qualities
all beings have exactly three such bodies
meaning.hi: सभी के तीन शरीर होते हैं

words.sanskrit: jagrat-svapna-sushupti-turiyash cha iti avasthah chatasrah tasam avasthanam adhipatayah chatvarah purushah vishva-taijasa-prajna-atmanah iti

meaning.en: four states -- waking, dreaming, deep sleep, the fourth -- and their four ruling presences: universal, shining, wise, and true self
meaning.hi: चार अवस्थाएँ -- जाग्रत, स्वप्न, सुषुप्ति, तुरीय -- और उनके चार अधिपति: विश्व, तैजस, प्राज्ञ, आत्मा

words.sanskrit: vishvah hi sthula-bhuk nityam taijasah pravivikta-bhuk anandabhuk tatra prajnah sarva-sakshi iti atah parah

meaning.en: the universal self experiences gross things, the shining self things apart, the wise self bliss, and beyond is the witness
meaning.hi: विश्व स्थूल भोगता, तैजस पृथक भोगता, प्राज्ञ आनन्द भोगता, और परे साक्षी

meaning.en: one should remain constantly bowed down toward all living beings
meaning.hi: सभी जीवों के प्रति सदा विनम्र रहे

words.sanskrit: abhiramah tu sarvasu hi avasthasu hi adhah-mukhah

meaning.en: and in every state remain facing downward, in humility
meaning.hi: और हर अवस्था में नीचे मुख किए रहे

words.sanskrit: akarah ukarah makarah iti vedah trayah lokah trayah gunah trini aksharani trayah svarah evam pranavah prakashate

meaning.en: the sounds A, U, M correspond to three Vedas, three worlds, three qualities, three syllables -- thus Om reveals itself
meaning.hi: अ-उ-म तीन वेद, तीन लोक, तीन गुण, तीन अक्षरों से मेल खाते -- इस तरह प्रणव प्रकट होता है

meaning.en: the A sound is present in the eyes of every creature during waking
meaning.hi: अ जाग्रत में नेत्रों में सभी प्राणियों में

words.sanskrit: ukarah kanthatah svapne makarah hridi suptitah

meaning.en: U is in the throat during dreaming, M is in the heart during deep sleep
meaning.hi: उ स्वप्न में कण्ठ में, म सुषुप्ति में हृदय में

meaning.en: the A sound is the universal self, gross, waking
the U sound is Hiranyagarbha, the shining self, subtle, dreaming
the M sound is the causal, unmanifest, wise self

words.sanskrit: akarah rajasah raktah brahma chetana uchyate

meaning.en: A carries rajas, red, called Brahma, pure awareness
meaning.hi: अ रजोगुणी, रक्त, ब्रह्मा चेतन कहा गया

words.sanskrit: ukarah sattvikah shuklah vishnuh iti abhidhiyate

meaning.en: U carries sattva, white, called Vishnu
meaning.hi: उ सात्त्विक, शुक्ल, विष्णु कहा गया

words.sanskrit: makarah tamasah krishnah rudrash cha iti tatha uchyate

meaning.en: M carries tamas, dark, called Rudra
meaning.hi: म तामसिक, कृष्ण, रुद्र कहा गया

meaning.en: from the syllable Om arises Brahma
from the syllable Om arises Hari
from the syllable Om arises Rudra
the syllable Om itself is the very highest reality

words.sanskrit: akare liyate brahma hi ukare liyate harih

meaning.en: Brahma dissolves into A, Hari dissolves into U
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा अ में, हरि उ में विलीन

words.sanskrit: makare liyate rudrah pranavo hi prakashate

meaning.en: Rudra dissolves into M, the syllable Om reveals itself
meaning.hi: रुद्र म में विलीन, प्रणव प्रकाशित

words.sanskrit: jnaninam urdhvago bhuyat ajnane syat adhomukhah

meaning.en: for the knower existence moves upward, for the ignorant it turns downward
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी के लिए ऊर्ध्वगामी, अज्ञानी के लिए अधोमुख

words.sanskrit: evam vai pranavah tishthet yah tam veda sah vedavit

meaning.en: the syllable Om remains present this way; whoever knows it is a true knower of the Vedas
meaning.hi: प्रणव इस तरह रहता है; जो जानता है वह वेदवित्

meaning.en: through its unstruck nature it carries a knower upward
meaning.hi: अनाहत स्वरूप से ज्ञानी को ऊर्ध्वगामी बनाता है

meaning.en: like an unbroken stream of oil
meaning.hi: तेल की अखण्ड धारा के समान

meaning.en: like the prolonged ringing of a great bell
meaning.hi: बड़ी घण्टी की लम्बी गूँज के समान

words.sanskrit: pranavasya dhvanih tadvat tat agram brahma cha uchyate

meaning.en: such is the resonance of Om, and its furthest reach is called brahman
meaning.hi: ऐसी है प्रणव की ध्वनि, इसकी पराकाष्ठा ब्रह्म कहलाती है

words.sanskrit: jyotirmayam tat agram syat avachyam buddhi-sukshmatah

meaning.en: that furthest reach is filled with light, too subtle for the intellect to express
meaning.hi: वह पराकाष्ठा ज्योतिर्मय है, बुद्धि से सूक्ष्म, अवाच्य

words.sanskrit: dadrishuh ye mahatmanah yah tam veda sah vedavit

meaning.en: the great souls who have seen it -- whoever knows it thus is a true knower of the Vedas
meaning.hi: जिन महात्माओं ने देखा -- जो जानता है वह वेदवित्

words.sanskrit: jagrat netra-dvayoh madhye hamsah eva prakashate

meaning.en: in the waking state, between the eyes, the syllable hamsa shines forth
meaning.hi: जाग्रत में नेत्रों के बीच हंस प्रकाशित

words.sanskrit: sakarah khechari proktah tvam-padam cha iti nishchitam

meaning.en: the sound sa is the khechari seal, representing the phrase you are
meaning.hi: स को खेचरी कहा गया, त्वंपद निश्चित

words.sanskrit: hakarah parameshah syat tat-padam cha iti nishchitam

meaning.en: the sound ha is the supreme lord, representing the phrase that

words.sanskrit: sakarah dhyayate jantuh hakarah hi bhavet dhruvam

meaning.en: sa is contemplated by every creature; ha remains the constant truth
meaning.hi: स ध्यान किया जाता, ह ध्रुव रहता

words.sanskrit: indriyaih badhyate jivah atma chaiva na badhyate

meaning.en: a living being is bound through the senses, but the self is never bound
meaning.hi: इन्द्रियों से जीव बँधता, आत्मा नहीं बँधती

meaning.en: through possessiveness a being arises; freed of possessiveness it stands alone
meaning.hi: ममत्व से जीव, निर्ममत्व से केवल

words.sanskrit: bhuh bhuvah svah ime lokah soma-surya-agni-devatah

meaning.en: earth, sky, heaven -- these worlds hold the divine powers of moon, sun, fire

words.sanskrit: yasya matrasu tishthanti tat param jyotih om iti

meaning.en: wherever these measures stand present, that is the highest light, Om
meaning.hi: जहाँ ये मात्राएँ स्थित, वह परम ज्योति ॐ

words.sanskrit: kriya ichha tatha jnanam brahmi raudri cha vaishnavi

meaning.en: action, will, knowledge correspond to the powers of Brahma, Rudra, Vishnu

words.sanskrit: tridha matra-sthitih yatra tat param jyotih om iti

meaning.en: wherever this threefold measure stands together, that is the highest light, Om
meaning.hi: जहाँ त्रिविध मात्रा-स्थिति, वह परम ज्योति ॐ

meaning.en: one should recite it constantly with the voice
one should practice it constantly with the body
one should recite it constantly with the mind too
that is the highest light, called Om

words.sanskrit: shuchih va api ashuchih va api yah japet pranavam sada

meaning.en: pure or impure, whoever recites the syllable Om at all times
meaning.hi: पवित्र या अपवित्र, जो सदा ओंकार जपे

words.sanskrit: na sah lipyati papena padma-patram iva ambhasa

meaning.en: is not stained by wrongdoing, like a lotus leaf untouched by water
meaning.hi: पाप से लिप्त नहीं, कमल-पत्र जल से अलिप्त की भाँति

meaning.en: when the wind moves, the precious fluid moves
meaning.hi: वायु चलने पर बिन्दु चलता है

meaning.en: when still, that fluid becomes still
meaning.hi: स्थिर होने पर बिन्दु स्थिर होता है

words.sanskrit: yogi sthanutvam apnoti tatah vayum nirundhayet

meaning.en: the yogi attains pillar-like steadiness -- so one should hold the breath in check
meaning.hi: योगी स्तम्भ-सदृश स्थिरता पाता है -- अतः वायु को रोके

words.sanskrit: yavat vayuh sthito dehe tavat jivah na munchati

meaning.en: as long as the wind remains in the body, the living being does not depart
meaning.hi: जब तक वायु देह में, जीव नहीं जाता

words.sanskrit: maranam tasya nishkrantih tatah vayum nirundhayet

meaning.en: its departure is death -- so one should hold the breath in check
meaning.hi: उसका जाना ही मृत्यु -- अतः वायु को रोके

words.sanskrit: yavat vayuh sthito dehe tavat jivah na munchati

meaning.en: as long as the wind remains in the body, the living being does not depart
meaning.hi: जब तक वायु देह में, जीव नहीं जाता

words.sanskrit: yavat drishtih bhruvoh madhye tavat kalam bhayam kutah

meaning.en: as long as the gaze stays between the eyebrows, why fear at that time
meaning.hi: जब तक दृष्टि भौंहों के बीच, तब भय कहाँ

meaning.en: Brahmin, this fear lasts only a little while
meaning.hi: हे ब्राह्मण, यह भय अल्पकाल का है

meaning.en: so one should practice control of the breath beyond it
meaning.hi: इसलिए प्राणायाम परे जाकर करना चाहिए

words.sanskrit: yoginah munash chaiva tatah pranan nirodhayet

meaning.en: it is for yogis and sages -- so one should genuinely control the breath
meaning.hi: यह योगियों-मुनियों के लिए -- अतः प्राणों को रोकना चाहिए

meaning.en: the hamsa moves outward across twenty-six finger-widths
meaning.hi: हंस छब्बीस अंगुल बाहर जाता है

meaning.en: control of the breath is achieved through the left and right pathways

words.sanskrit: shuddhim eti yada sarvam nadi-chakram mala-akulam

meaning.en: when the entire channel network, clouded with impurity, becomes fully purified
meaning.hi: जब मलिन नाड़ी-चक्र पूर्ण शुद्ध होता है

meaning.en: only then does a person become a yogi capable of holding the breath
meaning.hi: तभी योगी प्राण-निरोध में सक्षम बनता है

meaning.en: seated in the lotus posture, a yogi should draw breath through the moon channel
meaning.hi: पद्मासन में योगी चन्द्र से प्राण भरे

words.sanskrit: dharayet va yatha-shaktya bhuyah suryena rechayet

meaning.en: hold as capacity allows, then release through the sun channel
meaning.hi: शक्ति अनुसार रोके, फिर सूर्य से छोड़े

meaning.en: resembling an ocean of nectar, as white as fresh cow's milk

words.sanskrit: dhyatva chandramasam bimbam pranayame sukhi bhavet

meaning.en: meditating on the moon's reflected image, one finds happiness in breath control
meaning.hi: चन्द्रबिम्ब ध्याकर प्राणायाम में सुखी होता है

meaning.en: worthy of reverence, the blazing sun's disc

words.sanskrit: dhyatva hridi sthitam yogi pranayame sukhi bhavet

meaning.en: meditating on it as positioned in the heart, a yogi finds happiness in breath control
meaning.hi: हृदय में ध्याकर योगी प्राणायाम में सुखी होता है

words.sanskrit: pranam chet idaya pibet niyamitam bhuyah anyatha rechayet

meaning.en: if one draws breath in through ida, one should release it differently, through the other channel
meaning.hi: इडा से प्राण पीकर अन्यथा रेचन करे

words.sanskrit: pitva pingalaya samiranam atho baddhva tyajet vamaya

meaning.en: having drawn wind through pingala and held it, release through the left channel
meaning.hi: पिंगला से पीकर, बाँधकर बाईं से त्यागे

meaning.en: meditating in this way on the two measures of sun and moon
meaning.hi: इस विधि से सूर्य-चन्द्र के बिन्दु-द्वय का ध्यान

words.sanskrit: shuddha nadi-gana bhavanti yaminah masa-dvayat urdhvatah

meaning.en: the practitioner's channels become purified after two months
meaning.hi: यमी की नाड़ियाँ दो मास बाद शुद्ध होती हैं

meaning.en: holding the breath as desired, kindling the fire of digestion
manifestation of sound and health arise from purification of the channels

words.sanskrit: pranah deha-sthitah yavat apanam tu nirundhayet

meaning.en: so long as prana remains in the body, one should hold apana in check
meaning.hi: जब तक प्राण देह में, अपान को रोके

meaning.en: one matra equals a single full breath-cycle moving up and down through open space
meaning.hi: एक श्वास की मात्रा, आकाश में ऊर्ध्व-अधो गति

meaning.en: release, intake, and holding, woven through with the syllable Om
this is control of the breath, measured across twelve units
the sun and moon, joined across twelve units
should always be understood by yogis as preventing the web of fault

words.sanskrit: purakam dvadasham kuryat kumbhakam shodasham bhavet

meaning.en: intake should last twelve units, holding sixteen

words.sanskrit: rechakam dasha cha omkarah pranayamah sah uchyate

meaning.en: release should be ten, with the syllable Om -- this is control of the breath
meaning.hi: रेचक दस, ओंकार सहित -- यह प्राणायाम

meaning.en: in the lowest grade twelve units, in the middle grade double
meaning.hi: अधम में बारह, मध्यम में दोगुनी

meaning.en: in the highest grade triple -- this determines the levels of breath control
meaning.hi: उत्तम में तिगुनी -- प्राणायाम का निर्णय

meaning.en: in the lowest grade, sweating occurs; in the middle, trembling occurs
meaning.hi: अधम में पसीना, मध्यम में कम्प

words.sanskrit: uttame sthanam apnoti tatah vayum nirundhayet

meaning.en: in the highest grade one reaches a fixed position -- hold the breath in check
meaning.hi: उत्तम में स्थान प्राप्ति -- वायु को रोके

meaning.en: a yogi seated in the lotus posture, having bowed to Shiva as guru
meaning.hi: पद्मासन में योगी, गुरु शिव को प्रणाम कर

meaning.en: alone, gazing at the tip of the nose, should practice breath control
meaning.hi: अकेला, नासाग्र-दृष्टि, प्राणायाम का अभ्यास करे

words.sanskrit: dvaranam nava samniruddhya marutam badhva dridham dharanam

meaning.en: closing off the nine openings and binding the wind, holding a firm focus
meaning.hi: नौ द्वार बन्द कर वायु बाँधकर दृढ़ धारणा

words.sanskrit: nitva kalam apana-vahni-sahitam shaktya samam chalitam

meaning.en: drawing out the timing together with apana and inner fire, moved evenly
meaning.hi: अपान-अग्नि सहित समय को समान गति से ले जाना

words.sanskrit: atma-dhyana-yutah tu anena vidhina ghrini-asya murdhni sthiram yavat tishthati tavat eva mahatam sango na samstuyate

meaning.en: joined with self-meditation, held steady at the crown for as long as it lasts -- for that long no company of great beings is called equal
meaning.hi: आत्म-ध्यान सहित शिखर पर स्थिर, जब तक टिके तब तक महात्माओं की संगति समान नहीं

meaning.en: control of the breath practiced thus becomes a fire burning wrongdoing like fuel
meaning.hi: प्राणायाम पाप-ईंधन को जलाने वाली अग्नि

meaning.en: it is spoken of by yogis as the great bridge across the ocean of existence
meaning.hi: भव-सागर का महासेतु, योगियों द्वारा कहा गया

meaning.en: through posture, disease is destroyed
through breath control, wrongdoing is destroyed
the yogi is freed from mental disturbance through withdrawal of the senses
through concentration, mental steadiness arises with wonderful awareness

words.sanskrit: samadhau moksham apnoti tyaktva karma shubha-ashubham

meaning.en: in absorption one attains liberation, setting aside good and bad action
meaning.hi: समाधि में मोक्ष, शुभाशुभ कर्म त्यागकर

meaning.en: twelve breath-control cycles make up withdrawal of the senses
twelve cycles of withdrawal give rise to true concentration
twelve cycles of concentration make up meditation, say masters skilled in yoga
meaning.hi: बारह धारणा से ध्यान, योगविशारदों द्वारा कहा गया

meaning.en: and twelve cycles of meditation are called absorption
meaning.hi: बारह ध्यान से समाधि कहलाती है

words.sanskrit: yat samadhau param jyotih anantam vishvato-mukham

meaning.en: that highest light of absorption is boundless, facing every direction
meaning.hi: समाधि में परम ज्योति, असीम, सब ओर मुख

words.sanskrit: tasmin drishte kriya-karma yatayatah na vidyate

meaning.en: when it is seen, no coming and going, no action, exists
meaning.hi: उसे देखने पर क्रिया-कर्म, आना-जाना नहीं

words.sanskrit: sambaddha-asanam medhram anghri-yugalam karna-akshi-nasa-puta-dvara-adi angulibhih niyamya

meaning.en: joining posture, genital region, feet, restraining ears, eyes, nose openings with the fingers
meaning.hi: आसन-जननांग-पैर जोड़कर, अंगुलियों से कान-आँख-नाक रोककर

words.sanskrit: pavanam vaktrena va puritam badhva vakshasi bahu-ayana-sahitam murdhni sthiram dharayet

meaning.en: filling the wind through the mouth, binding it at the chest with inner passages, holding it steady at the crown
meaning.hi: मुख से वायु भरकर छाती पर बाँधकर, शिखर पर स्थिर धारण करे

meaning.en: masters of yoga come to share equally in that specific ultimate truth
meaning.hi: योगीश्वर उस विशेष तत्त्व-समता को प्राप्त होते हैं

words.sanskrit: gaganam pavane prapte dhvanih utpadyate mahan

meaning.en: when the wind reaches the inner space, a great resonance arises
meaning.hi: वायु के आकाश में पहुँचने पर महान ध्वनि उत्पन्न

meaning.en: comparable to bells and similar instruments -- this is accomplishment in inner sound
with breath control genuinely joined, every illness ends
for those disconnected from breath control, every illness arises
hiccups, coughing, breathing difficulty, pain in head, ears, eyes
meaning.hi: हिचकी, खाँसी, श्वास-कष्ट, सिर-कान-आँख का दर्द

meaning.en: various such disorders arise from disturbance in the flow of breath

words.sanskrit: yatha simhah gajah vyaghrah bhavet vashyah shanaih shanaih

meaning.en: just as a lion, elephant, or tiger comes under control very gradually
meaning.hi: जैसे सिंह-गज-व्याघ्र धीरे-धीरे वश में आते हैं

words.sanskrit: tatha eva sevitah vayuh anyatha hanti sadhakam

meaning.en: so too the breath, tended properly, cooperates -- otherwise it strikes down the practitioner
meaning.hi: वैसे ही सेवित वायु, अन्यथा साधक को मारती है

meaning.en: one should release the breath appropriately, and fill it appropriately
meaning.hi: उपयुक्त रीति से त्यागे, उपयुक्त रीति से भरे

meaning.en: one should hold it appropriately too -- through this one attains accomplishment
meaning.hi: उपयुक्त रीति से बाँधे -- इस तरह सिद्धि पाए

meaning.en: as the eyes and other senses move through their objects, each in its proper turn
meaning.hi: आँख आदि के विषयों में यथाक्रम गति करने पर

words.sanskrit: yat pratyaharanam tesham pratyaharah sah uchyate

meaning.en: drawing them back is what withdrawal of the senses is called
meaning.hi: उनका वापस खींचना ही प्रत्याहार कहलाता है
